title: Venezuela: Squandering a Gold Mine
summary:
Venezuela: Squandering a Gold Mine
While it is difficult to assess the degree to which daily life in Venezuela has deteriorated since president-elect Nicolas Maduro has taken the reins, general consensus indicates that the situation will likely get worse before it gets better. Anecdotes of consumer good shortages widely pepper the international press and sound alarms for international companies with exposure to Venezuela. As recently as 2000, Venezuela was producing upwards of 3.5 million barrels per day of crude oil.
